JobGuard AI is a full-stack application designed to protect job seekers from deceptive and malicious recruitment websites. It combines browser automation, risk detection rules, and AI-powered analysis to scan suspicious job portals and flag behaviors such as phishing attempts, fake application forms, credential collection, unsafe redirects .
